stories.title: Bilawal urges govt to stop 'fighting everyone'
stories.brief: Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari on Friday urged the federal government and political parties to set aside their differences and engage all political, social and provincial stakeholders to tackle the economic crisis.

stories.title: CDF Munir, Sudan's interior minister discuss avenues to enhance bilateral cooperation: ISPR
stories.brief: Chief of Defence Forces (CDF) and Chief of the Army Staff Field Marshal Asim Munir and Sudan’s Interior Minister Lieutenant General (Police) Babiker Samra Mustafa Ali on Friday discussed avenues to enhance bilateral cooperation between their countries.

stories.title: Turkish vessel to arrive in Karachi between Nov 17-20 to begin offshore oil, gas exploration
stories.brief: ISLAMABAD: A Turkish seismic vessel will arrive in Karachi between November 17 and 20 to begin offshore oil and gas exploration, the Petroleum Division said on Friday.

stories.title: CDF Munir, Sudan's interior minister pledge to deepen security and counterterrorism cooperation
stories.brief: Earlier in the day, Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar also met Sudan's interior minister, the Foreign Office said in a statement. The prime minister warmly welcomed the visiting dignitary and said Pakistan attached great importance to its longstanding and fraternal relations with Sudan.

stories.title: Turkish seismic vessel to reach Karachi in mid Nov for offshore oil, gas exploration
stories.brief: A Turkish seismic research vessel is expected to arrive in Karachi between November 17 and 20 to begin offshore oil and gas exploration, the Petroleum Division said on Friday, marking Pakistan's first major push to revive offshore exploration activities in two decades.

stories.title: Elon Musk appears to signal the end of the road for Cybertruck
stories.brief: Musk said it was to make room for production of its Cybercabs - autonomous taxis without a driver.

stories.title: AI stocks climb after trillions wiped from market values
stories.brief: Investors had been selling off tech shares in part due to concerns the Democrat election victory would mean slower AI development.

stories.title: A really simple guide to climate change

stories.title: Trump promotes Stephen Miller to chief of staff, replacing Susie Wiles
stories.brief: US President Donald Trump replaced chief of staff Susie Wiles with Stephen Miller on Friday, elevating the architect of some of his toughest domestic policies to run the White House after Republicans lost control of Congress in this week’s midterm elections.

stories.title: Banks, utilities among services put on alert against AI-enabled cyberthreats
stories.brief: The National Cyber Emergency Response Team (NCERT) has warned of an increased use of artificial intelligence (AI) and automated bots to carry out credential-based and coordinated cyberattacks, noting that critical infrastructure and financial services are at particular risk.

stories.title: PM seeks roadmap for cashless economy
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Saturday directed the relevant authorities to prepare a clear roadmap, with specific timelines and targets, for establishing a fully digital payment system across the country as the government steps up efforts to promote a cashless economy.

stories.title: AI tools increase cyberattack risks
stories.brief: It warned that banks could face attacks targeting core banking systems, digital banking platforms, payment systems and customer-facing applications. Critical infrastructure could also be exposed through vulnerabilities in third-party service providers, connected internet of things (IoT) devices, industrial control systems and insecure remote access, the advisory said.

stories.title: PM seeks roadmap for ‘100pc’ digital payments system, stresses countrywide internet access
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Friday directed authorities to prepare a “clear roadmap and time-bound targets” for establishing a 100 per cent digital payments system in the country.
